title: Cholesterol differentially modulates the activity of opioid and muscarinic receptors via a common binding site
authors: Nikolai Chetverikov; Alena Janoušková-Randáková; Dominik Nelic; Jan Jakubík
one_liner_zh: 该文研究胆固醇与GPCR（毒蕈碱和阿片受体）的结合位点及调节作用，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: G protein-coupled receptors (GPCRs) are membrane proteins that represent the largest and most therapeutically targeted receptor class, accounting for 30% of currently marketed drugs. Two binding motifs for membrane cholesterol, the cholesterol recognition amino acid consensus (CRAC) domain and the cholesterol consensus motif (CCM), have been postulated. Using a simulation of the molecular dynamics of cholesterol association with the receptor, we predicted the binding of membrane cholesterol to non-canonical sites, distinct from CRAC and CCM, at muscarinic and opioid receptors. We identified a binding site common to muscarinic and opioid receptors at TM6, with arginine 6.35 as the major residue. Membrane cholesterol depletion mimics the effects of R 6.35 mutations, confirming its role in receptor modulation. Targeting cholesterol-binding sites offers novel pharmacotherapeutic strategies, including tissue-specific sterol-based modulation. One sentence summary This study identifies a shared non-canonical cholesterol-binding site at TM6 in muscarinic and opioid receptors, with significant implications for drug development targeting tissue-specific GPCR modulation.
abstract_zh: G蛋白偶联受体（GPCRs）是膜蛋白，代表最大且最具治疗靶向性的受体类别，占当前上市药物的30%。已提出两种膜胆固醇结合基序：胆固醇识别氨基酸共有序列（CRAC）结构域和胆固醇共有基序（CCM）。通过模拟胆固醇与受体结合的分子动力学，我们预测了膜胆固醇在毒蕈碱和阿片受体上与非经典位点的结合，这些位点不同于CRAC和CCM。我们在TM6处识别出一个毒蕈碱和阿片受体共有的结合位点，其中精氨酸6.35是主要残基。膜胆固醇耗竭模拟了R 6.35突变的效果，证实了其在受体调节中的作用。靶向胆固醇结合位点提供了新的药物治疗策略，包括基于甾醇的组织特异性调节。一句话总结：本研究识别了毒蕈碱和阿片受体在TM6处共有的非经典胆固醇结合位点，对靶向组织特异性GPCR调节的药物开发具有重要意义。
